reviews.review_text:
Dean Arndell
Coolangatta, Australia169 contributions
0
Cà Phê Morning Wife & Family
Jan 2020 • Family
Wow!! Once my wife Nga & I walked in we were amazed at the size of the café inside, amazing! Beautiful lights, Têt Luna New Year decorations, waterfalls & gardens. We had watermelon & sugar apple smoothie which was nice, I was expecting more flavor maybe. Café sua nong (hot w/milk) was great, I do love the smaller cups of Vietnamese coffee with great strong taste!
I highly recommend Du Miên Garden Café to any café lovers whilst in Saigon as it's an experience in itself. They also had a great menue of food, & we saw many families eating, as was our's before they flew home to Hue. 
Càm òn rât nhiêu! :)

reviews.review_title: Review at Du Mien Garden Cafe
reviews.review_text:
Mancunianabroad90
Rome, Italy159 contributions
0
Lovely atmosphere, shame about the food
Sep 2018 • Couples
After reading some good reviews, we visited the garden cafe on a Sunday afternoon. There was no one to seat us on arrival, so we wandered around the levels for a while and it is very well designed, tranquil and relaxing. We eventually found a counter and asked one of the staff if we could have a table, their level of English wasn’t brilliant but we managed to get a small table near where we had actually wanted to sit...I ordered vermicelli noodle soup with seafood, my partner ordered beef and cauliflower and we had a side of fries to share. The food did come quite quickly but all of it was luke warm at best. The fries were very cold and my vermicelli noodle soup turned out to be dry vermicelli noodles with prawns, fish balls and baby octopus thrown on....unfortunately we were not able to speak to the staff about the poor quality of food as it was difficult to get past the language barrier. The food isn’t expensive by any means so I wasn’t expecting it to be amazing, just hot would have been nice. We would potentially come here for drinks again, but not to eat.
